Name: Fruitastic Hats (FS)
Author: Molenfeuer
Description:
[size=5][b]Install[/b][b]
[/b][/size][list=1]
[*]Download the newest version of this mod from NexusMods or the GitHub [url=https://github.com/Nordmole/FruitasticHats/releases]release page[/url]﻿
[*]Extract the ZIP-File and put the folder into the mods folder of SMAPI (mostly located under "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods")
[/list][size=5][b] 
Usage[/b][/size]
When you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ installed you are able to buy the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Hand-Mirror-Tool]Hand Mirror[/url]﻿ from Pierres. Use the mirror to open the FS menu and checkout the "Hat" tab. Swipe through the menu to checkout this fruitastic hats.
[b][size=5]
Features
[/size][/b][list]
[*]Adds some fruity and icy (mainly icy) hats
[i]Yes... I know that strawberries and bananas are not really fruits... but its hard to find a good name, right?
[/i][/list][b][size=5]
Contribute[/size]
[/b]If something doesn't work, or you miss a feature, feel free to open a new issue on the [url=https://github.com/Nordmole/FruitasticHats/issues]GitHub Page of this mod[/url]﻿. I prefer the GitHub Page but if you really don't want to use it feel free to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17408?tab=bugs]Issue Page here on NexusMods[/url]﻿.[b]
